context.note: The owner's refusals for an app's Google client and its sign-in methods. The Kernel runs every case (mcp.rs tests); the editor shows the Kernel's answer and routes it by code. Each case starts with no secret set and Google off unless it says otherwise.

cases.case: the client secret, with use left out
the client secret pasted as the client ID
cases.error: This looks like the client secret. The client ID ends with .apps.googleusercontent.com.

cases.case: a client ID that is too short
cases.error: A secret value is 16 to 512 printable ASCII characters without spaces.

cases.case: a client secret with a space
cases.error: A secret value is 16 to 512 printable ASCII characters without spaces.

cases.case: a Google name with another use
cases.error: google_client_id and google_client_secret hold this app's Google client. Set them with use google.
A secret with use google is named google_client_id or google_client_secret.

cases.case: deleting the client secret while Google is on
cases.error: Google sign-in is on for this app and needs google_client_secret. Turn Google off before deleting it.

cases.case: deleting the client secret once Google is off
Google before the client is set
cases.error: Set this app's Google client ID and client secret before turning Google on.

cases.case: Google once the client is set

cases.error: Password sign-in cannot be turned off, so every account keeps a way back in.

cases.case: a method the Kernel does not know
cases.error: Name the methods as password and google.
